name: cavemio-ratio-balancer
title: Ratio balancer
description: A multi-segment allocation track. Drag dividers to rebalance constrained percentages with zero initial jump.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Dividers act as semantic separators with vertical orientation and aria-valuenow.
- Delta-based drag ensures 1:1 finger tracking without initial jumping on touch devices.
- Segments maintain pure DOM styles during drag; React state updates occur only on commit.
- Reduced motion removes flex-grow easing transitions and rolls digits in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: label
props.description: – · Accessible heading displayed above the allocation bar.

props.name: segments / defaultSegments
props.description: – · Array of segment objects with id, label, and ratio (summing to 100).

props.name: minRatio
props.description: 5 · Minimum allowed percentage for any segment during drag.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · Fired during divider movement with immediate ratio updates.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: – · Fired upon pointer release or keyboard adjustment with clean normalized integers.

useCases.title: Traffic splits
useCases.description: Divide traffic between variants of a test or a rollout.

useCases.title: Budget allocation
useCases.description: Split a budget between channels or teams.

useCases.title: Resource quotas
useCases.description: Share compute or storage across projects in cloud settings.

features.title: Always 100%
features.description: On release every ratio is normalised to whole numbers that add up to 100.

features.title: Drag the dividers
features.description: Moving a divider rebalances the two segments beside it. It tracks your finger one to one, with no jump at the start.

features.title: A minimum share
features.description: No segment can drop below minRatio, 5% by default.

features.title: Numbers that roll
features.description: The percentages roll to their settled totals when you let go.

features.title: Commit when done
features.description: onValueChange fires while dragging, and onValueCommit fires on release or a keyboard change.

features.title: Keyboard and screen readers
features.description: Dividers take focus, Left and Right nudge by 1% (5% with Shift), and each divider reports its value.

states.title: rebalance
states.description: Dragging a divider updates adjacent segment flex-grow styles and DOM text nodes directly.

states.title: settle
states.description: Releasing the pointer normalizes all ratios to 100% and rolls final percentage digits via NumberRoll.

states.title: keyboard
states.description: Dividers accept focus; Left and Right arrow keys nudge allocations by 1% (or 5% with Shift).
